title.narrative: Strengthening Economic Management and Governance Program, Subprogram 2

description.narrative: The program designed as a programmatic approach with two subprograms was approved by ADB Board of Directors in December 2024 to deepen macroeconomic and fiscal management reforms, improve tax revenue mobilization, enhance governance of state-owned enterprises (SOEs), and achieve economic diversification and export competitiveness. Subprogram 2, supported by increased lending of $750 million (up from the originally planned $500 million), advances critical reforms in domestic resource mobilization (DRM), public investment management (PIM), governance of SOEs, improvement of investment climate and enabling environment for the private sector, and trade facilitation.
